Application No.: 22426

SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code of-Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 18-K in the following area:

A line 1,379.22 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South
Cicero Avenue;

a line 71.32 feet east of and parallel to South Cicero Avenue;

a line through a point 71.32 feet east of South Cicero Avenue and 1,401.08 feet north of West 77th
Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue, and a point 222.73 feet
east of South Cicero Avenue and 1,402.44 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east
right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue;

a line through a point 222.73 feet east of Cicero Avenue and 1,402.44 feet north of West 77th Street
as measured along the east right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue, and a point 222.33 feet east of
South Cicero Avenue and 1,444.44 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east right-
of-way line of South Cicero Avenue;

a line through a point 222.33 feet east of South Cicero Avenue and 1,444.44 feet north of West 77th
Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue, and a point 365.48 feet
east of South Cicero Avenue and ],448.72 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east
right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue;

a line through a point 365.48 feet east of South Cicero Avenue and 1,448.72 feet north of West 77th
Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue, and a point 377.00 feet
east of South Cicero Avenue and 1,400.05 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east
right-of-way line of South Cicero Avenue;

a line 377 feet east of and parallel to South Cicero Avenue;

a line 1,052.36 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South
Cicero Avenue;

a line 292 feet east of and parallel to South Cicero Avenue;

a line 1,126.36 feet north of West 77th Street as measured along the east right-of-way line of South
Cicero Avenue; and

a line 25.72 feet east of and parallel to South Cicero Avenue;

to those of C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District, which is hereby established in the
area above described.

SECTION 2: This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 7503-7525 S. Cicero Avenue.
